source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Ubuntu and x64 Try aliases retain linux64 names and replace linux1804 test prefixes with linux2404. The parser expands those prefixes; the direct test expects four gtest platform names. Test-platform YAML still maps linux2404 variants to linux64 build platforms, while the test-kind image becomes ubuntu2404-test. These names serve different roles. The changed parser test does not prove that a VM, container or whole task graph ran.
title: The Ubuntu test migration updates aliases, mappings and the default image together
